name: whizchool
description: School management for Sri Lankan schools: admissions, records, attendance, results, fees and a parent portal.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @whizchool/api" "npm run dev -w @whizchool/web"
scripts.preview: npm run build -w @whizchool/web && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @whizchool/api" "npm run start -w @whizchool/web"
